RetroStone Arcade Free - RetroStone VC games by 8BCraft
Code: MIT licence. Games' art, music and levels: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LICENSE-*.txt). (c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft)

The free edition of the RetroStone Arcade app, on your PC: the menu shows every RetroStone VC game; three are free to
play (Leady Squid, Pancake Tower, Beaver Rush), the others are in the full version (the padlock opens its page).

Run: double-click RetroStoneArcadeFree.exe (a single file, SDL2 is linked in). The window can be resized; a wider
window shows the menu with more columns.

Menu
  Arrows / D-pad      choose a game              Enter, X or A    play (a locked game: its "full version" page)
  The "i" (top left): Credits & licences; the "?" (top right): help. Esc or the back arrow closes them
  Mouse              click a card to play it, drag to scroll (the phone's touches)
  Esc                 leave the app

In a game
  Arrows, X = A, Z = B, C = Y, V = X, Q = L, E = R, Enter = Start, Backspace = Select (each game's README)
  Gamepads: up to 4, SNES layout (bottom = B, right = A)
  Esc, the pad's Guide button or the back arrow (top left)   back to the menu: the game is saved where it was and resumes there next time
  Mouse clicks are the phone's touches (Leady Squid, Pancake Tower: click = A; Beaver Rush: left / right half)
  F11 or Alt+Enter    fullscreen          F12   screenshot

Saves: %APPDATA%\8BCraft\com.eightbcraft.retrostonearcade.free\ (each game's .srm best scores and .state).
Options: RetroStoneArcadeFree.exe --scale N, --fullscreen, --saves DIR.
